title: Austin daily weather
agency: NOAA NCEI / GHCN-Daily, Austin Camp Mabry
cleaning: Request metric daily minimum/maximum air temperature (°C) and precipitation (mm).
Retain source attribute flags and missing fields; no interpolation.
limitations: Air temperature is not water temperature; rain is measured at Camp Mabry, not at the lake.
Attribute strings preserve measurement, quality and source flags; trace rain must not be treated as exact zero.
No solar radiation or hourly observations included.
